questions.q: Bazaar's program builds the catalog in a variable, then ends. What happens to the catalog?
options: It's gone: memory is wiped when the program ends, unless you saved it to a file
It stays until the computer restarts
questions.explain: Variables live in memory (RAM), which is handed back when the program stops. Files on the disk stay.

questions.q: Why use with open(...) as f: instead of plain open()?
options: with closes the file automatically when the block ends, even if an error happens
It's the only way to read files
questions.explain: Forgetting to close files can lose data or run out of file handles. with does it for you.

questions.q: You open data/orders.log with mode "w" just to read it. What happens?
options: The file is emptied immediately; the old orders are lost, with no error
questions.explain: "w" empties the file before writing. To read, use no mode (or "r"); to add, use "a".

questions.q: Python's True and None become what in JSON?
questions.explain: JSON uses lowercase true/false and null, and only double quotes for text. json.dump does the conversion for you.

questions.q: A cart was saved with f.write(str(cart)). Why does json.load fail on it?
options: str(cart) writes Python's own text, with single quotes; JSON needs double quotes
questions.explain: JSONDecodeError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes. Save with json.dump(cart, f) instead.

questions.q: A new customer has no saved cart file yet. What should load_cart() do?
options: Catch FileNotFoundError and return an empty cart
Catch every error with a bare except
questions.explain: A missing file is expected on a first visit. Catch exactly FileNotFoundError (and JSONDecodeError for broken files).

questions.q: (Going deeper) Why write to a temp file and then os.replace() it over the real file?
options: If the program dies halfway, the real file is still the complete old version, never half-written
questions.explain: os.replace swaps the new file in in one step. A crash during writing only damages the temp file.

questions.q: (Going deeper) json.dumps({"Patel Spices", "Meera Handloom"}) fails. Why?
options: JSON has no sets: TypeError: Object of type set is not JSON serializable. Convert to a list first
questions.explain: JSON has objects, arrays, text, numbers, true/false and null. sorted(sellers) gives a list that JSON can hold.
